bio: Zoetermeer harbours a secret oasis that is waiting to be discovered. This enchanting estate boasts a chef’s table in a wine barn, a wedding venue in a converted stable, a terrace overlooking a lush garden, not to mention a stylish restaurant in a converted 17C farmhouse. The hospitality here is genuine, as is the kitchen team's appreciation of their ingredients. Alain Adriaanse shares his passion by delivering dishes that give familiar flavours the odd twist. With an Asian touch and fresh flavours, he elevates the sea bass tartare to new heights. He also puts a unique spin on steak tartare by adding playful textures. The extensive wine list is the icing on the cake....
